name: DirectVoxGO Model Initialization
definition: Initialization of the DirectVoxGO neural radiance field model, setting up density grids, segmentation masks, and color networks based on bounding box coordinates and voxel counts.
summary: DirectVoxGO Model Initialization sets up density grids, segmentation masks, and color networks, distinguished by explicitly calculating density bias for initial transparency and managing dual segmentation mask grids for iterative refinement.
